sensei_drum.brief: Create drum patterns that drive club energy with emphasis on groove suitable for Trip Hop and incorporate sample chopping for rhythmic interest.

bass_generator.brief: Generate bass lines that complement the drums with a smooth uplifting feel that fits the experimental Trip Hop style.

harmony_generator.brief: Provide harmonic support using sample-based chord layers with textures matching micro chops and phrase chops techniques.

melody_generator.brief: Develop melodic fragments focusing on experimental sample chops and subtle textural effects without traditional melodic runs.

ai_designer.brief: Coordinate arrangement structure ensuring energy dynamics follow club energy profile and mood remains uplifting.

presetor.brief: Manage presets emphasizing sample chopping techniques on vocal and instrumental channels.

songgps.brief: Monitor arrangement transitions and section energy curve to ensure smooth flow and impact for club-oriented Trip Hop.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare mixing approach that preserves clarity of chopped vocal and sample layers and emphasizes club energy.
